records.rationale: Retain the single generic source change increasing DRM_OBJECT_MAX_PROPERTY to 96 for Android source-module custom properties; omit both generated historical ABI graphs. Exact SDK demand above 64 is unconfirmed, so this is conservative compatibility retention, not a claim that current virtual drivers require it. Both property/value arrays use the same bound and native attach_property checks before insertion; traversal uses initialized count. Registration belongs to trusted driver setup. Costs 512 additional bytes per container on x86_64; exposes only properties the driver actually attaches. Native access/value/lifetime checks remain. Rebuilt modules use the new layout; no historical binary KMI is retained.

The historical increase from 24 to 64 was represented by native LTS. It is now superseded by the explicitly retained 96-property capacity of fd1f129aa0a0, not still textually present as a 64 limit. Preserve native array bounds/iteration and rebuild modules. The previous whole-file textual-presence witness is retained in drm-property-capacity-review.json and removed from active text-presence records.
